description: This file defines structures and functions for creating and building deep link URLs to share content with an agent within the OpenClawKit app. It includes data structures for payload content and methods for constructing and sanitizing share messages.

classes.name: SharedContentPayload
classes.description: A data structure representing optional shared content elements such as title, URL, and text.

methods.name: buildURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL with embedded message for sharing, based on a payload and optional instruction.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Generates a formatted message string from a payload and instruction, with character limit enforcement.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newline characters from a string, returning nil if the result is empty.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Truncates a string to a specified maximum length if necessary.
